basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Seattle, Washington, with a passion for optimizing hardware. I work as a systems analyst by day and tinker with PCs by night. I enjoy helping others with their tech queries and am a frequent contributor on tech-related subreddits. In my downtime, I’m into hiking and exploring the local coffee scene. I'm currently single and spend most of my online hours in the evenings and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington. My expertise comes from both formal education and years of self-taught experimentation with computer hardware. I actively follow tech forums and keep up with the latest trends in overclocking and system optimization.
